segments.description: 2D animated graphics illustrating bike shifters, derailleurs, and cogs operating on a bicycle.
An image of a walnut transitions to text overlaying a grid background reading 'GEAR RATIOS'.
Animated diagrams calculating bicycle gear ratios with tooth counts, formulas, and wheel rotations.

hook.opening_visual: An animated bicycle cog rotating on a crumpled paper background alongside text.
hook.opening_line: Cogs means a 9 speed bike and so on.
hook.notes: Introduces bicycle gear concepts using simple flat graphics and quick voiceover.
